sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS severe_days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Kanpur' AND aqi_category = 'Severe' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2024-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-02-28' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days_with_value FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Lucknow' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-11-30' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT city, ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city IN ('Delhi', 'Kanpur', 'Lucknow', 'Mumbai') AND date BETWEEN CAST('2023-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-02-29' AS DATE) GROUP BY city ORDER BY avg_aqi DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT date, aqi FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE) AND NOT aqi IS NULL ORDER BY aqi DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Mumbai' AND aqi_category = 'Good' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS days_very_poor_or_worse FROM city_aqi_daily AS d JOIN aqi_categories AS c USING (aqi_category) WHERE d.city = 'Delhi' AND c.severity_rank >= 5 AND d.date BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-02-28' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days_with_value FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Kanpur' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2024-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-10-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS days FROM city_aqi_daily AS d JOIN aqi_categories AS c USING (aqi_category) WHERE d.city = 'Lucknow' AND c.severity_rank >= 5 AND d.date BETWEEN CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT prominent_pollutant, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Mumbai' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY prominent_pollutant ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STRFTIME(date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days_with_value, COUNT(*) AS total_days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2024-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-11-30' AS DATE) AND (date BETWEEN CAST('2024-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-11-30' AS DATE) OR date BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-11-30' AS DATE)) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS severe_days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND aqi_category = 'Severe' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2023-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days_with_value FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY avg_aqi ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS days FROM city_aqi_daily AS d JOIN aqi_categories AS c USING (aqi_category) WHERE d.city = 'Kanpur' AND c.severity_rank <= 2 AND d.date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT date, aqi FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Lucknow' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) AND NOT aqi IS NULL ORDER BY aqi ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(aqi), 1) AS avg_aqi, COUNT(aqi) AS days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Mumbai' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2024-06-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-09-30' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS severe_days FROM city_aqi_daily WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND aqi_category = 'Severe' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-01-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS days_poor_or_worse FROM city_aqi_daily AS d JOIN aqi_categories AS c USING (aqi_category) WHERE d.city IN ('Kanpur', 'Lucknow') AND c.severity_rank >= 4 AND d.date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY city ORDER BY days_poor_or_worse DESC LIMIT 1000
